range_decision.evidence: The trajectory exhibits a permanent step offset starting around index 518 across all three components (N, E, U). The N and U axes show an abrupt downward shift of approximately 9-20 MAD units, while the E axis shows a downward shift followed by a gradual recovery. Crucially, there is no opposing return to the original baseline levels for any component; the data remains at the new level through the end of the monitoring period (index 729). Therefore, this event represents a permanent step rather than a temporary observation offset.
